answer: A bond is refunded only after 34 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The prism counter is kept in tide and cedar shows each reset. An copycat therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 34 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1333 identities would post 4751 proofs and burn roughly 40 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
